title: Complete canonical master and sales print snapshot seams in the finite shared legacy registry
description: Stage 2 reusable platform migration only. No standalone report, arbitrary SQL/joins, production database/deployment, secret/config edits or permission expansion; preserve concurrent work, all old routes and four-stage order. ERP330 RegisterPrintTemplateFamilies only binds bill families and doc-center; existing master-data and quotation/PI print families remain unavailable. Add one reusable finite canonical print snapshot reader covering registered master and sales families and base-data I/O sources. Reuse or extract actual BaseDataIoController/BaseDataControllers and QuotationController/GetPrint, ProformaInvoiceController/GetPrint logic with fresh current-user menu, column and salesperson/customer scope checks; retain old routes and response semantics. Do not call generic dataset providers as the old side or invent business calculations. Exact original header/detail identities, stable SortNo/Id order, null, currency/unit, raw amounts and empty documents are preserved. Unknown/deleted/inaccessible sources fail closed under execution bounds/cancellation and audit correlation.
